releaseNotes:
Player Layout Fix: Restored album art packed constraints and header separation.
Notification Square Artwork: Automatic center-crop preprocessor eliminates 16:9 black pillarbox bars in system media controls.
Instant High-Volume Warning: BroadcastReceiver listener triggers warning pill immediately on hardware volume changes >= 80%.
Sound Check Auto-Leveling: Automatically normalizes volume to safe hearing level on track change when enabled.
Modern MusicDeck Logo: Bespoke sound deck emblem with Android 14+ Material You / Dark Mode themed icon support.
